subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Session-Based Testing
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Session-Based Testing.

hook.text: Explore for 90 minutes. Write down what you tested, what you found, and what's left. That's a session.

buildup.text: Session-based test management (SBTM) gives exploratory testing a framework: charters, time-boxes, and debriefs.

discovery.text: A charter defines the mission: 'Explore payment flow with expired cards and network errors for 60 minutes.'

twist.text: The debrief is critical. Without it, session-based testing is just untracked exploration with no accountability.

climax.text: Managers track coverage via session sheets: what was explored, what was found, and what percentage was on-charter.

punchline.text: Time-box it. Charter it. Debrief it. Exploration with structure.

quiz.question: What gives session-based testing its structure?
